verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials describe issuing instant virtual cards for each software subscription with per-vendor spending limits and no shared card numbers (ramp-docs-31). Funds can be restricted to allowed merchants, merchant categories, amounts and intervals (ramp-docs-41, ramp-supp-spend-controls-agents), and custom virtual cards and reusable virtual card details are documented (ramp-docs-11, ramp-docs-7, ramp-supp-agent-cards). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, explicit documentation of issuing vendor cards from procurement/PO flows, and explicit documentation of locking a single compromised vendor card in isolation.
